### Upcoming Meetings

- **Winston’s Mayor, Christie Knutson** will be at Winston City Hall on Saturday, July 5th from 10 – noon for open conversation and coffee. [More Info](https://winstoncity.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/coffee-with-the-mayor.pdf)
- The Winston **City Council** will meet July 7, 2025 at 7 o’clock pm in the council chambers at City Hall, 201 NW Douglas Blvd. [More Info](https://winstoncity.org/government/city-council)
- The Winston **Economic Development Committee** will meet July 9, 2025 at noon in the council chambers at City Hall, 201 NW Douglas Blvd.
- **The Winston Planning Commission** will meet July 9, 2025, 7:00 PM at Winston City Hall, 201 NW Douglas Blvd. [More Info](https://winstoncity.org/government/planning-commission)
- **Winston’s Mayor, Christie Knutson** will be at Winston City Hall on Saturday, August 2nd from 10 – noon for open conversation and coffee. [More Info](https://winstoncity.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/coffee-with-the-mayor.pdf)

### Public Meeting Schedule

- Winston City Council 1st and 3rd Mondays at 7pm; City Hall, 201 NW Douglas Blvd.
- Winston Urban Renewal Agency 3rd Thursday at 5:30; City Hall
- Winston Economic Development Committee 2nd Wednesday at noon; City Hall
- Winston Park Board 2nd Tuesday at 4; City Hall
- Winston Planning Commission 2nd Wednesday at 7pm; City Hall
